why: × and ÷ have the same rank, so go left to right: 18 ÷ 3 = 6, then 6 × 2 = 12.
In −2² the power only applies to the 2, and the minus comes after: −(2²) = −4. The brackets in (−2)² square the whole −2.
The right side is a − b + c, so the two sides only agree when c = 0. Subtraction can't be regrouped.
